scope: two paired uploads, six selected layer-0/1 LoRA-A blocks; public uploads only
formula: r=-delta/lr; g=eps*r/(1-abs(r)) for first step with zero moments and weight_decay=0
limitations: bf16 gradient control is FP32-master mixed; bf16-master comparison is descriptive because its forward rounding may differ
only finite unsaturated coordinates are inverted; not a complete gradient reconstruction or text attack
FP32 AdamW finite moment arithmetic and parameter subtraction can make ideal inverse ill-conditioned
